was: Lincoln County park on the west edge of Lake Benton, ~800 acres of woodland/prairie. 33 sites all with electric + water (RVs to ~33 ft), dump station, showers, hiking trails. Reservable, open mid-May through October. --Claude
note: Lincoln County park on the west edge of Lake Benton, ~800 acres of woodland/prairie. 33 sites all with electric + water, hiking trails. Reservable, open mid-May through October. --Claude

was: City of Morris campground on Pomme de Terre Lake, with water and electric sites, tent sites, restrooms and showers, a spray park, a disc golf course, a dock, canoeing, fishing and a playground.  The city shuts the park's water off in mid-October; camping continues without it. --Claude
note: City of Morris campground on Pomme de Terre Lake, with water and electric sites, tent sites, restrooms, a spray park, a disc golf course, a dock, canoeing, fishing and a playground.  The city shuts the park's water off in mid-October; camping continues without it. --Claude

was: City of Blue Earth campground at the Faribault County Fairgrounds, runs all season (May 1-Oct 1), not just fair week. 14 full-hookup (50/30-amp) sites accommodating RVs to ~50 ft; showers, WiFi, dump. Reservable online. --Claude
note: City of Blue Earth campground at the Faribault County Fairgrounds, runs all season, not just fair week. Reservable online. --Claude

was: State recreation area on the Missouri River below Oahe Dam, 5 mi north of Fort Pierre. 3 campgrounds, 205 electric campsites, camping/modern cabins, dump station, boat ramps. Campgrounds 1 & 2 close Nov 15 to late March for bald eagle roosting; Campground 3 open year-round. Reservable online. --Claude
note: State recreation area on the Missouri River below Oahe Dam, 5 mi north of Fort Pierre. 3 campgrounds, 205 electric campsites, camping/modern cabins, boat ramps. Reservable online. --Claude

was: Camping at the state-operated South Dakota State Fairgrounds in Huron; 1,200+ electric/water sites plus 50 full-hookup, restrooms - the state's largest campground (nightly self-contained FCFS at the gate; fair-week package reservations via the admin office). --Claude
note: Camping at the state-operated South Dakota State Fairgrounds in Huron; 1,200+ electric/water sites plus 50 full-hookup, restrooms - the state's largest campground. --Claude

was: ND state park on Beaver Lake, ~5 mi SE of Wishek. Modern campground of 25 electric/water drive-in sites on an oval loop (a former half-mile horse-racing track), plus primitive sites and 3 lakeside camping cabins; showers, flush toilets, dump station, picnic shelters. Camping mid-May through Labor Day. Reservable online (95 days out) or by phone. --Claude
note: ND state park on Beaver Lake, ~5 mi SE of Wishek. Modern campground of 25 electric/water drive-in sites on an oval loop (a former half-mile horse-racing track), plus primitive sites and 3 lakeside camping cabins; picnic shelters. Reservable online (95 days out) or by phone. --Claude

was: City of Pembina park on a peninsula at the Red River of the North. ~12-14 RV sites with water/sewer and 30/50-amp electric, plus primitive tent sites ($10); showers, boat ramp/dock, fish-cleaning station, playground, disc golf. --Claude
note: City of Pembina park on a peninsula at the Red River of the North. Primitive tent sites, boat ramp/dock, fish-cleaning station, playground, disc golf. --Claude

was: Chouteau County Fair-operated campground in Fort Benton beside the Missouri River canoe launch (river mile 0 of the Upper Missouri Breaks); a separate site from the fair's ChoCoFair Campground at the fairgrounds. Free day-use parking by the launch ramp for boaters and floaters; the launch is a popular summer tubing spot. Seasonal (May-Nov). --Claude

was: Flathead NF at the north end of Swan Lake, ~17 mi SE of Bigfork. Two loops (Ponderosa open/large sites, Birch shaded); boat ramp and swim beach on the lake side of Hwy 83. --Claude
note: Flathead NF at the north end of Swan Lake, ~17 mi SE of Bigfork. Boat ramp and swim beach on the lake side of Hwy 83. --Claude

was: Bitterroot NF, Bass Creek Recreation Area, ~2 mi up Bass Creek Road off US-93 north of Stevensville; open meadow, nature and fire-ecology trails, trailheads into the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness. The nearby Larry Creek group site is reservable via recreation.gov. Campground host Memorial Day-Labor Day. --Claude
note: Bitterroot NF, Bass Creek Recreation Area, ~2 mi up Bass Creek Road off US-93 north of Stevensville; open meadow, nature and fire-ecology trails, trailheads into the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness. --Claude

was: Kootenai NF, 7 mi NW of Troy on Hwy 2 at the confluence of the Yaak and Kootenai rivers; sites on both sides of the Yaak, garbage service in season. Run by the Three Rivers Ranger District. --Claude
note: Kootenai NF, 7 mi NW of Troy on Hwy 2 at the confluence of the Yaak and Kootenai rivers; garbage service in season. Run by the Three Rivers Ranger District. --Claude

was: NPS campground in Bighorn Canyon NRA on the south shore of the Afterbay (Bighorn River) near Fort Smith, on the right of MT-313 just past the NPS headquarters; unpaved roads, 'all vehicles OK in good weather'. Grapevine Creek's north-shore sites are a separate NPS campground. --Claude
note: NPS campground in Bighorn Canyon NRA on the south shore of the Afterbay (Bighorn River) near Fort Smith, on the right of MT-313 just past the NPS headquarters; unpaved roads, 'all vehicles OK in good weather'. --Claude

was: Kootenai NF boating site on the west shore of Lake Koocanusa, about 25 mi NE of Libby via FDR 228. The 3 open-area sites (fire rings) are the ones that take an RV; the other 4 are in the boat-dock parking area. Paved road and boat ramp with dock; native-surface spurs. --Claude
note: Kootenai NF boating site on the west shore of Lake Koocanusa, about 25 mi NE of Libby via FDR 228. Paved road and boat ramp with dock. --Claude

was: Kootenai NF campground at the north end of Bull Lake, 13 mi south of Troy on Hwy 56, among mature pines. The 2 RV sites are near the swimming beach and the boat ramp with dock; the rest are a tent-only area and a host site. A security gate is closed 10 pm to 7 am by the camphost. --Claude

was: NPS Chickasaw NRA primitive campground on the western shore of Lake of the Arbuckles; RVs permitted, water spigots, fire rings, boat access. Open seasonally (about Memorial Day-Labor Day). --Claude
note: NPS Chickasaw NRA primitive campground on the western shore of Lake of the Arbuckles; RVs permitted, fire rings, boat access. --Claude

was: City of Chandler municipal park on Bell Cow Lake; camping Areas A/B/C on a lake point with pull-through & back-in electric/water RV sites (to ~40 ft), some equestrian sites w/ pens, restrooms/showers, boat ramps. Reservable. --Claude
